import sqlite3
import json
from pathlib import Path

def migrate_wordpress_posts(wp_export_path: str, db_path: str) -> int:
    """Convert WordPress XML export to Vanilla Press SQLite."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            meta TEXT NOT NULL,
            blocks TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)

    posts = parse_wp_export(Path(wp_export_path))
    for post in posts:
        blocks = html_to_blocks(post["content"])
        meta = {"title": post["title"], "slug": post["slug"]}
        cursor.execute(
            "INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (post["id"], json.dumps(meta), json.dumps(blocks))
        )

    conn.commit()
    count = len(posts)
    conn.close()
    return count

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
OUTPUT_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR/dist"

echo "Building static site..."
node "$PROJECT_DIR/bin/publish.js" --output "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "Running tests..."
node --test "$PROJECT_DIR/test/**/*.test.js"

if [[ "${CI:-}" == "true" ]]; then
  echo "Deploying to Cloudflare Pages..."
  npx wrangler pages deploy "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    --project-name vanilla-press \
    --branch "${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-main}"
else
  echo "Skipping deploy (not in CI)"
fi

echo "Done."

-- Full-text search across documents
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents_fts USING fts5(
  title,
  content,
  content=documents,
  content_rowid=rowid,
  tokenize='porter unicode61'
);

-- Query with ranking
SELECT
  d.id,
  json_extract(d.meta, '$.title') AS title,
  json_extract(d.meta, '$.slug') AS slug,
  rank
FROM documents_fts
JOIN documents d ON d.rowid = documents_fts.rowid
WHERE documents_fts MATCH ?
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 20;
